metadata.description: amir marketplace — two plugins, every command under /amir:

plugins.name: amir_system
plugins.description: User-scope core: project lifecycle (create/onboard/orchestrate/inspect/manage), Graphify wrappers, Asana + Playwright MCP, system rules. Available before any project exists.

plugins.name: amir_project
plugins.description: Project-scope component groups (harness, cloud, security, network, dev tooling, evaluation). Never auto-enabled; installed per project or rendered as a manifest-selected subset.

plugins.name: Amir_PAB
plugins.description: General skills for accessing and driving the Prisma Access Browser (PAB) desktop app with the cua computer-use driver, including the mandatory read-only security gate.

plugins.name: Amir_PAB_SCM
plugins.description: Expert navigation of Strata Cloud Manager (SCM) running inside the Prisma Access Browser.

plugins.name: Amir_PAB_CIE
plugins.description: Expert navigation of the Cloud Identity Engine (CIE) web UI running inside the Prisma Access Browser.

plugins.name: Amir_PAB_CSP
plugins.description: Expert navigation of the Palo Alto Networks Customer Support Portal (CSP) web UI running inside the Prisma Access Browser.
